usage: 湯碗 is a noun that refers to a bowl used specifically for soup.
It is common to use 湯碗 when talking about dining and kitchen items in Cantonese.
湯碗 can be used to specify the type of bowl when differentiating from other bowls such as rice bowls or cereal bowls.
湯碗 can appear in sentences to describe actions like filling, washing, or carrying the bowl.
It can be used in both singular and plural contexts without changing form, just by the quantity word added.
